page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head "ME" centred at top, page number 295 at top right. Main text in one column of entries in Greek, Latin and Greek-Latin mixed type. Left edge shows a fragment of the facing left page with marginal text, which is not transcribed as it is the edge of the neighbouring page.

main_text.p: Μέρος τὸ pars, ἐκ μέρους ex parte, quadantenus, Roman.11.25. ἀνὰ μέρος vicissim 1.Cor.14.27. κατὰ μέρος singulatim, Heb.9.5. Th.μερίζω divido.
Μεσημβρία ας ἡ meridies. q.d. merus vel medius dies, ex μέση dimidia & ἡμέρα ας ἡ dies. μεσημβρινὸς ἡ ὀν meridianus.
Μεσίτης ου ὁ mediator 1.Tim.2.5. internuntius, Gal.3.19.
Μεσιτεύω proprie, fum mediator. Nam verba in μεσιτεύω exponuntur per fum, item intervenio, fidejubeo. Fut. μεσιτεύσω. aor.1. ἐμεσίτευσα. P. μεμεσιτευκα.
Μεσονύκτιον ου τὸ q.d. μέση νύξ, media nox.
Μεσουράνημα ος τὸ medium coeli. ἀ μεσουρανίω ὢ fum in medio coeli. ex μέσος medius, & οὐρανὸς coelum.
Μεσόω ῶ fum medius. part.praes. μεσούων ὧν, οὖσα ὄσα, οὖν ἓν medius a um.
Μέσος η ον medius a um. μέσον ου τὸ substantivè medietas, dimidium. ἀνὰ μέσον seq. Genit. inter.
Μεσοτοιχον ου τὸ intergerinus paries. comp. ex τοῖχος ου ὁ paries & μέσος intermedius,
main_text.l: Μεσσίας ου ὁ Messias, vox Hebraea. Latinè unctus, Graece Χριστὸς.
main_text.p: Μεστὸς ἡ ὀν plenus, refertus a um, cum Genit.
Μεστόω ῶ repleo, refercio. Fut. ώσω. P. μεμεστωκα. praes.pass. μεστοῦμαι ὑμαι plenus sum, impleor.

page.notes: Greek and mixed Greek-Latin entries are transcribed as best read; several Greek words are uncertain and may contain errors in accents. Left-hand facing page fragment omitted.
